project_type: Laravel 11 ERP — PHP 8.4, SQLite in tests, MySQL in production
build_system: Composer. No frontend build step relevant to this task.
test_framework: Pest (php vendor/bin/pest). Feature tests under tests/Feature/. Unit tests under tests/Unit/.
verification_instructions: 1. Run targeted file: php vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/CrossCurrencySettlementTest.php --no-coverage — expect 15/15 pass. 2. Run full suite: php vendor/bin/pest --no-coverage — expect 163 tests, 0 failures. 3. After any PHP edit run: vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent
environment_constraints: Do not run migrations manually — RefreshDatabase handles this in tests. Do not run tinker. All test helpers (makeCrossContext, makeCrossUsdPurchase) are defined in the test file itself.
contribution_requirements: After modifying any PHP file, run vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent to fix code style. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion. All methods must have explicit return types and type hints. Never leave open transactions or partial writes.
key_patterns: PaymentService uses DB::transaction wrappers. preparePaymentAttributes() builds the full payment payload including applied_* fields. postPaymentJournal() is private and called by all three public payment methods. AccountingService enforces line.currency === account.currency on postJournal(). FinancialAccount uses TenantScoped global scope — bypass with withoutGlobalScope(CompanyScope::class) and then check company_id manually.
directory_structure: app/Services/ — all service classes. app/Models/ — Eloquent models with TenantScoped trait. app/Eloquent/ — CompanyScope global scope. tests/Feature/ — Pest feature tests, each uses RefreshDatabase. database/migrations/ — ordered migrations, all already run. database/factories/ — ExchangeRateFactory and UserFactory.
